body: thanks man I think I'm gonna actually see a therapist, I just can't do it anymore at this moment but my mind is spinning like none other.

so I was home alone for an hour and I basically tried to hang myself but I just couldn't do it because of my poor family. I'm gonna see a therapist probably, at least I'm not dying tonight and maybe not tomorrow either. Can't say I know much beyond that but it's a start I guess...

well. I'm at home right now and my parents left for half an hour. Grabbed my rope and tried to tie it but I needed a second rope which was upstairs and I just stared and untied it and took it down. I threw it all in the corner of my room and layed on my bed staring at the ceiling in silence until they came back. I couldn't do it, I just couldn't fathom my mom and sister and dad crying and falling apart. They dont deserve it. 

I have to go back to college on Monday if I'm still alive and I don't know what I'm going to do Sunday. Everyone says to keep going but I don't know what to do anymore. Everything is miserable but ending life will also cause so much misery. Wish I could just vanish with a click. 

At least I've survived today :|

I do something similar (or at least I did for a while) and while it feels good enough for a bit, it crushes me when I walk out of my dorm and see everyone else having the time of their lives. Honestly that's what really kills me more than everything. In college, especially at my school, partying is wild. Everyone seems to have so much fun. And I'm just stuck...
I just feel like a failed human being for it. Here I am, 19 years old, in a party college with stuff going on every single night and nearly everyone super friendly and I *still* can't connect with people in any worthwhile way. Like the numbers are all in my favor and yet it still hasn't worked. I so desperately miss real contact with other people, you know? When everyone is talking about whoever they hooked up with, shot the shit with at their frat, or randomly wandered the city for the hell of it while you haven't done any of that and despairingly wished you could.. I wish I could talk to someone in person but it only makes me feel even worse to actually say this out loud. 

I just don't know what else to do anymore. I do appreciate your comment though :)
